# AbstractEntity

> The Entity app for AbstractFramework, published on npm as `@abstractframework/entity`: create entities (AI companions with a lasting memory that live on your AbstractGateway), talk with them, watch their memory as a live graph, and read their diaries. A thin React client served by the `abstractentity` command with no server state of its own; every view is read from the gateway and the memory engine's replay stream.

Key facts:
- Run: `npx @abstractframework/entity` (or `npm install -g @abstractframework/entity`, then `abstractentity`). Serves `http://127.0.0.1:3007`, and at `/apps/entity/` through a gateway that manages it; Node.js 18 or newer; launch flags `--gateway-url` (aliases `--gateway`, `--url`; default: the gateway installed on this computer from `~/.abstractframework/gateway.json`, else `http://127.0.0.1:8080`), `--port`, `--host` (default `127.0.0.1`); `ABSTRACTENTITY_GATEWAY_URL`, `PORT`, `HOST` are legacy aliases below the flags.
- First entity: with no entity the app shows "No entities yet" and a **Create your first entity** button; `/#new` (or `/#/new`) opens the creation form directly. Type a **Name** and press **Create entity**; **Advanced: starting document** takes your own YAML. The gateway console's **Create your first entity** button needs AbstractGateway 0.4.1 or newer; the app works with any gateway.
- URLs: `/?entity=NAME` (live), `&live=0` (replay from the start), `/?page=blueprint`, `/?src=URL` (exported stream); with no reachable gateway the app opens a bundled demo life.
- Sign-in: the shared app-origin proxy (`POST /api/connection/gateway`, HttpOnly cookies, `/api/gateway/*` proxied); tokens never stored in the browser. With `@abstractframework/app-server` 0.1.10 or newer the proxy sends the browser's connection address as `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-AbstractFramework-App-Proxy: abstractentity` to the gateway.
- Responsive layout (README "Responsive layout"): below 1024 px the side panel is a drawer over the graph (Escape, outside tap or close button); below 768 px or on a phone held sideways the tabs are a bottom strip and dialogs open as bottom sheets; with the on-screen keyboard open an open panel fills the screen above it; graph overlays go compact below 860 px of graph width; the blueprint has a zoom bar (fit, −, +, reset); below 768 px the transcript, ledger, health panel and entity list are flat full-width sections; below 1024 px the Detail tab's lists fold (remembered per browser) and the Cognitive Monitor starts folded on phones; touch targets are at least 44 px, text fields 16 px, no text under 14 px on touch screens (transcript 15 px); desktop text at least 13 px (ledger and tool grants 12 px).
- Voice in a visit (docs/api.md "Voice uses the same gateway routes"): a reply's speaker (or Read aloud) posts to `POST /entities/{name}/voice/tts/stream` with no voice field, so the entity's own voice (else the gateway `output.voice` default) speaks, streamed sentence by sentence, Stop aborts; the composer microphone uploads the recording to session `entity_voice_<name>` and transcribes with `POST /runs/{run}/audio/transcribe` (gateway default STT unless overridden), showing `Transcribing… N s · <route>`, failing as a sentence after 180 s; Settings → voice = the ui-kit `AfVoiceSection` (devices, mic test, language, Read aloud; defaults from `GET /voice/defaults`; no text-to-speech override). Needs AbstractGateway 0.13.0 or later.
- Digital identity (docs/api.md "Identity and track record"; framework ADR 0052; AbstractGateway 0.20.0): Settings → identity = the ui-kit `IdentityPanel` (look, voice with a sample on the entity's own lane, Create a new voice, history, one Save at the bottom): the entity's avatar design (AbstractAvatar catalog, Watch-drawable designs only) + colour + voice, one Save (`PUT /entities/{name}/identity`, the whole record); a refusal's sentence shown verbatim, never retried, with a Download button from `error.download`; a record without a voice shows the gateway's `note` sentence, never a voice; History = every `?rev=N`, newest first. Settings → track record = sessions/runs/successes/failures/tokens, trust per task kind with its support ("No experience yet" at 0), whom it met (people, entities). The Avatar view draws the visit's `identity_ref` (open answer or newest public update) in its design and colour; none = the kit's avatar.
- Cognitive Monitor without embeddings (503 on `POST /embeddings`): "Embeddings are not configured on this gateway, so the cognitive monitor cannot run." plus a **Set up embeddings** link to the console's Multimodal page (`/console#defaults`); every other refusal shows its `detail` sentence (`refusalDetail` in `src/stream_source.ts`), never the JSON body.
- State at any scrub position is a pure fold of the replay stream; replay, live tail and scrub are one code path. Diary redaction is never reconstructed; tool use renders from data, never prose; the cognition wave reads the expressive character of the entity's words, not inner state.
- Life cycle (docs/entity-phases.md): five states, idle (awake, nothing to do; a new entity starts here), personal (own time, granted or taken back only by the guardian with the `personal` toggle), work (jobs queued for it; no work switch), visit (opens in every state except stopped, waits for the current step without failing, returns to the previous state), sleep (maintenance: consolidates and enriches memory; returns to the previous state); an idle entity sleeps once `sleep.after_hours` (default 24, 1-720) or `sleep.after_events` new memories (default 500) since its last sleep are reached (Settings → Mind → Sleep, `GET/PUT /entities/{name}/cognition-profile`). Stop halts everything and revokes own time; Resume lands idle. Every interaction forms a memory. Routes (docs/api.md "Life cycle"): `GET /entities/{name}/life_state`, `PUT …/life_state/toggles {personal}`, `POST …/lifecycle {action: stop|resume|retry}`, `POST …/state {state: sleep, dream: true}`; live `phase_changed` host events on the replay stream, highest `rev` wins. Older gateways: "This gateway does not serve the phase bar yet." Known limits: a Stop may let one in-flight model call finish; a mention's visit closes after 5 minutes without a new mention.
- `@` mentions (docs/api.md "Mentions in a conversation"): in a visit or flow-brain conversation, `@` offers the entities `GET /entities` returns (not the one visited); each picked chip is one `POST /sessions/{session_id}/mentions {entity, text, mention_index, repeat_of?, mention_id}`, sent in pick order after the previous answered (the second reads the first); answers labelled from `author` (avatar, name, "entity" tag); 409 "<name> is in another conversation." then the next; 503 puts words and unanswered chips back; a resend with the same `mention_id` returns the first answer; a gateway without the route: "This gateway does not offer mentions yet".
- Optional Avatar conversation (README): Chat remains the default; Avatar centers one live line of public updates and a Findings panel without changing work, drafts or file controls. New Avatar visits and Flow turns opt in to public updates. Durable visit guidance/answers use owned visit routes; summoned Flow turns use their principal-owned replay view and commands. Only explicit public updates and screened replies enter captions or narration. Needs AbstractGateway 0.19.0 or newer; the live line's finding/progress types and the Findings panel need 0.20.0. Questions, permission requests and completion each signal with both a visual and an audio cue (no cue settings inside the view); read-aloud uses the entity's existing voice; history/reconnect/hidden panels stay silent.

## Core docs

- [README.md](README.md): what an entity is and its life cycle, your first entity, install and run, the app's surfaces (phase bar, `@` mentions), responsive layout, known limits.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, sign in, create your first entity, talk with it.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components and gateway routes (Mermaid diagrams), the replay-stream fold, `src/` module map, invariants, serving.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): command, environment variables, app URLs, server routes, gateway routes the app uses, the life cycle (phase bar, sleep thresholds), `@` mentions, voice in a visit.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): entities, names, starting documents, what an entity does when nobody talks to it, diary privacy, gateway versions, the About dialog (`GET /api/gateway/about`), phones and tablets.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): demo instead of entities, sign-in, missing console button, creation refusals, gaps, the phase bar not served, own time stopped unexpectedly (Retry), mentions not offered, the Cognitive Monitor without embeddings, About showing the gateway unavailable, ports, copy over plain http (tailscale serve), build.

- [docs/Overview.md](docs/Overview.md): goals, the challenge, core components, honesty invariants.
